_comment: Every entry is a triple: behavior, verification command, state. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. Granularity: each feature should be completable in one session.

features.name: HybridACD bound math matches Table 1 consistency rules
features.behavior: get_consistency_bounds() in hybrid_acd_forecaster.py returns [l,u] intervals matching the algebraic formulas in paper Table 1 (Negation, Paraphrase, And, Or, Cond at minimum) for known previous predictions.
features.evidence: test_bounds_neg_checker, test_bounds_paraphrase_checker, test_bounds_and_checker already exist and pass in repo as of current commit

features.evidence: test_hybrid_acd_config_dump_load exists and passes in repo

features.name: Full-pipeline smoke run produces a valid AVS on a live model
features.behavior: Running evaluation.py with HybridACDForecaster on 5 scraped-tuple questions against a real model API exits 0 and stats_summary.json contains a non-null AVS field.
features.evidence: Full -k all 10-checker run (num_lines=5, 50 samples) on scraped: exit 0, AVS=0.000 across default/frequentist/default_scaled (commit 9dbcc77). Model=gpt-5.6-luna via reseller, not gpt-4o-mini as originally specified — see ADR-004 (permanent model policy change) and unresolved endpoint question below. CAVEAT (ADR-005): scraped's clean AVS is very likely training-data memorization of already-resolved May-Aug 2024 events, not genuine forecasting-under-uncertainty — do not cite as evidence of consistency-enforcement quality. CONFIRMED (ADR-005 follow-up, 2028 spot-check): re-run on src/data/tuples/2028 (unresolved, no leakage possible) produced genuine intermediate probabilities (e.g. 0.03, 0.95, 0.012, 0.93, 0.07) with real interval-bound enforcement (e.g. Fréchet bound [0.0,0.03] respected, not collapsed to a point) — this is the run that actually validates the mechanism works under real uncertainty. TCD intervention logging added and confirmed at least one genuine clip_fallback intervention (NegChecker sample, raw != final). ADR-006: logit-bias path has never fired on any reseller endpoint tested (xah.io, wokushop) — confirmed via direct empirical probe (scratch/test_logit_bias.py) that these proxies silently no-op logit_bias in the request payload. Live evidence to date reflects prompt-injected-bound + deterministic-clip, not logit-bias steering; this does not invalidate AVS as a consistency measure (clip fallback deterministically enforces bounds regardless) but should be described accurately. ruff clean, 16/16 unit tests pass (F001/F002 not regressed by pipeline fixes).

features.name: Reproduce paper's AVS reduction on at least one model, on both scraped (paper-comparable) and 2028 (leakage-clean)
features.behavior: TWO required runs, per decision logged 2026-08-29 (not optional, not sequential-then-pick-one): (a) full 200-line evaluation on src/data/tuples/scraped with HybridACDForecaster, model=gpt-5.6-luna via wokushop — report AVS against paper's reported 0.0007 (paper Table 2) WITH the ADR-005 leakage caveat attached to any comparison, since this model's training data very likely covers the scraped set's May-Aug 2024 resolution window. (b) same run on src/data/tuples/2028 — this has no paper-table equivalent to compare against (the original paper never tested on 2028), so report its AVS standalone as the leakage-clean measurement of whether HybridACD's mechanism does real work under genuine uncertainty. Both numbers go in the same write-up, neither is optional, and (a) must not be presented without (b) alongside it or the leakage caveat gets silently dropped in future citations.
features.verification: see docs/verification.md 'Full evaluation' section for the base command; run twice with --tuple_dir pointed at scraped then 2028 respectively, -o model=gpt-5.6-luna (via wokushop, per DECISIONS.md endpoint addendum), --output_dir src/data/forecasts/HybridACD_gpt-5.6-luna_scraped_run and _2028_run respectively. Compare (a)'s AVS to paper Table 2's 0.0007 with the leakage caveat stated explicitly in the same sentence, not a footnote. Report (b) standalone. Smoke-scale first (num_lines=5) before the full 200-line run per small-before-large rule, since this is real API cost either way.

features.name: Reproduce ablation study (TCD-only vs adversarial-only vs full)
features.behavior: Three evaluation runs (adversarial_enabled/tcd_enabled toggled per paper Table 5) on gpt-4o-mini reproduce the qualitative ordering: full < TCD-only < adversarial-only for AVS.
features.verification: see docs/verification.md 'Ablation' section, three runs + manual AVS comparison

features.name: Calibration Error regression investigation (Mistral models)
features.behavior: Paper flags increased Calibration Error on Mistral-Medium-3.5 and Mistral-Small-4 after HybridACD as unresolved ('†'). Investigate whether narrower [l,u] intervals correlate with the regression, propose a soft-penalty alternative to hard clipping.
features.verification: written analysis + notebook comparing interval width vs calibration delta per question, no fixed pass/fail command yet — define one before marking active

features.name: Retrieval-augmented small-model forecasting
features.behavior: Add a pre-elicitation retrieval step (news/context search) to HybridACDForecaster, run before adversarial rewrite + TCD, with a hard date-cutoff filter enforced AT THE SEARCH-PROVIDER API LEVEL per question (never as prompt text alone — proven insufficient, see evidence) to prevent outcome leakage on already-resolved tuple sets (e.g. src/data/tuples/scraped). Hypothesis: a small model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini or smaller) with clean, leakage-free retrieval closes most of the Brier-score gap to a large model without retrieval, while TCD keeps AVS low regardless of model size or retrieval.
features.verification: Non-retrieval baselines already exist on disk (confirmed 2026-08-23) — no fresh runs needed: small = BasicForecaster_gpt4o_mini_2024-07-18_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.202, CE 0.142; tuples_scraped AVS 0.0300 default / 0.1874 freq); large = BasicForecaster_gpt4o_2024-08-06_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.179, CE 0.065) or CoT_ForecasterTextBeforeParsing_o1-preview_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.168). ResolverBasedForecaster_llama-3.1-sonar-large-128k_20240501_20240815 (Brier 0.096) is CONFIRMED UNUSABLE as an upper-bound reference (see evidence) — do not cite it in any comparison table. Before implementation: select a search provider with a verified absolute end-date parameter (e.g. Tavily end_date, Exa end_published_date, Bing News date-range) per ADR-003 — check that provider's current docs directly, do not assume. Then run the treatment (HybridACDForecaster + audited-clean retrieval, small model, num_lines=5 smoke scale first) and report against the two disk baselines above in one table per docs/conventions.md baseline-first rule. Falsifiable prediction to state before running: Brier(small+retrieval) should land closer to Brier(large, no-retrieval) than to Brier(small, no-retrieval); if not, that's the finding.
features.evidence: Audited 2026-08-23: ResolverBasedForecaster (src/forecasters/various.py) passes created_date/resolution_date into the prompt as plain text only (src/perplexity_resolver/prompts.py); no date parameter reaches the actual Perplexity API call (src/common/perplexity_client.py::_prepare_payload sends no search_recency_filter or equivalent). Perplexity's search_recency_filter is relative-only (month/week/day/hour) and cannot express an absolute historical cutoff at all, even if wired up. Result: its live search returns post-resolution news for the already-resolved scraped set, the model reads the outcome off those articles, and reports can_resolve_question=True with p in {0.001, 0.999} — confirmed outcome leakage, not forecasting. Its 0.096/0.088 Brier scores are excluded as an F007 reference. Full ADR in DECISIONS.md ADR-003.
features.blocked_by: F003 (smoke run harness must be proven working before adding a retrieval step to it); search-provider selection with a verified absolute date-cutoff parameter (see verification)
